spans.s:
After the verb क्लिप् 'to be fit', परस्मैपद is optionally used, when लुट् (1st Future) is affixed, as well as when स्य and सन् are affixed.

Terms: परस्मैपद

डा , रौ and रस् are substituted respectively in the room of the three-affixes of the 3rd Person of लुट् (First Future), both in the prSmEpd and आत्मनेपद। 

Terms: विभक्ति-elision
